title: Final velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as √2 v₀.

title: Final distance from M
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as (√2 v₀²)/g.

title: Velocity vector decomposition
description: Important: The student must decompose the final velocity into horizontal (v₀) and vertical components, recognizing they are equal when the trajectory is tangent to the 45° barrier.

title: Time of flight calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the time of flight using vertical kinematics under gravity (t = v_y / g).

title: Horizontal displacement
description: Important: The student must compute the horizontal distance traveled (x = v₀ t) before applying the geometric factor to find PM.

title: Geometric relation for PM
description: Important: The student must use the 45° geometry to relate the horizontal displacement x to the distance PM along the barrier (PM = √2 x).

title: Electric field role
description: Optional: The student may note that the given electric field strength ensures the net force is purely gravitational, simplifying the problem.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns signs to velocity components or misinterprets the direction of motion relative to the barrier.

title: Incorrect tangent condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student fails to apply the condition that the ball's velocity is parallel to the barrier (45°) at the point of closest approach.
